keyEvents.text: Delay in match because of an injury Nicolas Kocik (Le Mans).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Goal! Le Mans 0, Monaco 1. Mamadou Coulibaly (Monaco) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal.
First Half ends, Le Mans 0, Monaco 1.
Second Half begins Le Mans 0, Monaco 1.
Substitution, Monaco. Paris Brunner replaces Aleksandr Golovin because of an injury.
Substitution, Monaco. Takumi Minamino replaces Mathys Detourbet.
Substitution, Monaco. Folarin Balogun replaces Matthis Abline.
Substitution, Le Mans. Adnane Kharroubi replaces Jean Vercruysse.
Substitution, Le Mans. Erwan Colas replaces Dame Gueye.
Substitution, Monaco. Jordan Teze replaces Mamadou Coulibaly.
Substitution, Le Mans. Antoine Rabillard replaces Daouda Traoré.
Substitution, Le Mans. William Harhouz replaces Louis Mafouta.
Substitution, Le Mans. Noa Boissé replaces Lucas Buadés.
Substitution, Monaco. Christian Mawissa replaces Flávio Nazinho.
Goal! Le Mans 1, Monaco 1. Erwan Colas (Le Mans) right footed shot from very close range to the high centre of the goal following a corner.
Delay in match because of an injury Eric Dier (Monaco).
Delay in match because of an injury Samuel Yohou (Le Mans).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Second Half ends, Le Mans 1, Monaco 1.
